import sys

MOD = 998244353
HALF = (MOD + 1) // 2

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    N, M, L, R = map(int, data[:4])
    cells = N * M
    base = R - L + 1
    exponent = cells
    result = pow(base, exponent, MOD)
    if cells % 2 == 1:
        print(result)
    else:
        if (R - L) % 2 == 0:
            result += 1
        result = (result * HALF) % MOD
        print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
